place.title: Kalkan Han Hotel
place.address: Kalkan, Süleyman Yılmaz Cd. No:3, 07580 Kaş/Antalya, Türkiye

reviews.snippet: We stayed at the Kalkan Han hotel for a week in September 2025. This was our second visit to the hotel and as before we booked one of the 2 rooftop suites which had a roof terrace with views over the old town to the sea and a hot tub. The room was spacious, spotlessly clean and stylishly furnished with everything we needed. The hotel is on a pretty street in the heart of the old town so very convenient for all the restaurants, shops and bars and with a short walk to the harbour for complementary water taxis to the various beach clubs. Resul Aydn and all his staff were friendly and helpful. Whilst we were there, I cut myself badly while I was out for the day. Resul could not have been more kind in personally driving us to a local doctor, organising for the cost of the treatment to be put on our bill and collecting my prescription. We would certainly recommend the Kalkan Han and we hope to return to stay again next year. A particular highlight for us was the delicious breakfast in the charming street at the front of the hotel.

We couldn’t be happier with our stay at Kalkan Han Hotel! Everything was perfect – the staff are incredibly friendly, attentive and welcoming without ever being pushy. They even helped us arrange a wonderful boat trip, which made our holiday extra special. The hotel has the most perfect location, beautifully and charmingly decorated, making us feel right at home from the very first moment. We will definitely come back and will gladly recommend it to our friends and family. A true gem in Kalkan! 💎❤️

The hotel has an excellent location, with a wonderful restaurant downstairs serving delicious food. The rooms are spotless, stylish, and everything feels brand new. A special thank you to the staff for their attention to detail and genuine care for the guests — it truly made our stay unforgettable!

Plaja da çok yakın arabamızı üst sokağa bıraktık . Her yaz gitmeliyim dediğim bir işletme çok teşekkürler iyiki yollarımız sizle kesişmiş :)

A Perfect Week in Kalkan – Warm, Welcoming, and Unforgettable.

We had the absolute pleasure of spending a week at this beautiful hotel in Kalkan – and everything about our stay was simply perfect.

From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with genuine warmth. The entire team is incredibly caring, attentive, and always eager to make guests feel comfortable and at home. You don’t just feel like a guest here – you feel like part of a family.

The rooms and the entire property are spotless and beautifully maintained. One of the standout features is the hotel’s fantastic location: it has direct access to a stylish restaurant and bar, ideal for relaxed evenings with great food and drinks. At the same time, the charming center of Kalkan is just a short walk away.

The real highlight, though, is the breathtaking view – overlooking both the town and the shimmering sea. Whether you’re enjoying breakfast, watching the sunset, or just taking in the scenery, the view is absolutely unforgettable.

A heartfelt thank you to the entire team for making our week so special – we will definitely be back!
